title: Integrate datasheets with ewing-open-data-catalog
context: Backlog (unscheduled) integration task for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Cross-links this benchmark's datasheets and accession records with the sibling ewing-open-data-catalog project so the two inventories reuse one another rather than duplicating curation. Only open, licensed, accession-level metadata is shared; the open-data and compliance guardrails carry over (no controlled-access data).
objective: Cross-link the benchmark datasheets and accession records with the ewing-open-data-catalog inventory so entries are mutually discoverable, sharing only open licensed metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Datasheets and accession records are linked to the corresponding ewing-open-data-catalog entries (stable identifiers both ways).
Only open, licensed, accession-level metadata is shared; no controlled-access or re-hosted data; provenance recorded.
output: data/crosslink/ — cross-reference records linking benchmark datasheets to ewing-open-data-catalog entries.
